name: Decreto-Lei n.º 130/2026
summary: Amends the electricity framework, including ACC principles, proximity, internal rules and DGEG information duties.
evidence: Articles 83, 86, 86-A and 90 are relevant. Article 10 specifies commencement 60 days after publication; article 9 limits application to new prior-control procedures.
unknowns: Map and voluntary-contract duties do not prove those services are available. Confirm transitional application and current implementing rules.

name: Decreto-Lei n.º 15/2022
summary: Foundational electricity-system legislation containing the Portuguese self-consumption and energy-community framework.
evidence: Original act: self-consumption provisions and articles 189–191 on CER and CCE.
unknowns: The 2022 text has been amended, including by DL 130/2026. Use the amended/consolidated provisions and check transition rules before acting.

name: Regulamento n.º 815/2023
summary: ERSE’s Regulamento do Autoconsumo covers commercial relationships, metering, data and sharing arrangements.
evidence: The official act approved the RAC and repealed Regulamento n.º 373/2021. ERSE links it from its self-consumption page.
unknowns: Available sharing modes and the operational process must be confirmed with the network operator for each project.

name: E-Redes: EGAC data guide
summary: January 2026 guidance describes sFTP data provision and distinguishes fixed/proportional sharing from dynamic/hierarchical schedules.
evidence: The document is network-operator guidance, rather than a legislative amendment. The month comes from the document version.
unknowns: Confirm the applicable data service, authorisations and file format for the specific community.

name: Renewable Energy Directive
summary: Directive (EU) 2018/2001 provides the renewable-energy-community definition and enabling framework.
evidence: Article 2(16) defines RECs and article 22 addresses their framework. National implementation determines practical pathways.
unknowns: Amended by Directive (EU) 2023/2413 (RED III), which DL 130/2026 states it partially transposes. Use the consolidated directive and the national implementation together. This record is not an amendment monitor.

name: Electricity Market Directive
summary: Directive (EU) 2019/944 provides the citizen-energy-community definition and framework.
evidence: Article 2(11) defines CECs; article 16 sets their framework. CEC and REC definitions have different scopes.
unknowns: Amended by Directive (EU) 2024/1711, which DL 130/2026 states it transposes. Review the consolidated directive and national implementation. An EU definition does not itself confirm project eligibility.
